description: This Java source file provides utility methods for camera operations in an Android application, including selecting optimal video sizes, obtaining camera instances (front and back), and creating media files for images and videos.

classes.name: CameraHelper
classes.description: A utility class for handling various camera operations such as selecting sizes, retrieving camera instances, and file management.

methods.name: getOptimalVideoSize
methods.description: Selects the most suitable video size based on preferred aspect ratio and view dimensions.

methods.name: getDefaultCameraInstance
methods.description: Returns the default camera object available on the device.

methods.name: getDefaultBackFacingCameraInstance
methods.description: Returns the default rear-facing camera object.

methods.name: getDefaultFrontFacingCameraInstance
methods.description: Returns the default front-facing camera object.

methods.name: getDefaultCamera
methods.description: Internal method that fetches a camera based on the specified position (front or back).

methods.name: getOutputMediaFile
methods.description: Creates a media file (image or video) in the public Pictures directory with a timestamped filename.
